disagreements.reason_1: A build-skeleton unit with no E item is the practice of every .NET product here; paths are the dotnet defaults. Statable as a K-BOM rule.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: the .sln name is the product name and the core project path follows the E-BOM's planned paths (all under src/MoviePad.Core/). Judged: a skeleton unit with no E item owning the solution and both projects; the csproj could as well belong to a content unit.

disagreements.reason_1: Target framework, nullable and packages come from K-DOTNET-001 and procurement; InternalsVisibleTo and "no package in the core" are the product's practice.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: net10.0, nullable, no package in the core (K-DOTNET-001), the four test packages (K-DOTNET-001 via procurement), .gitignore kept. Judged: InternalsVisibleTo for the test project, which no ruled text asks for. Alternative: tests through the public API only, no InternalsVisibleTo.

disagreements.reason_1: One library vs a project per unit: both reasonable; a trade-off.
disagreements.reason_2: Every E item's planned_output_artifact_ref lies under src/MoviePad.Core/ (Editing/, Output/, Media/, Export/), so one class library with folders per unit follows; namespaces per folder are the C# convention.

disagreements.reason_1: One unit per E item, the artifact path is the E item's planned_output_artifact_ref; file names are one file per public type of the form. No written rule maps E items to units 1:1.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: ebom_refs [E-DOCUMENT-001] and the folder copy E-DOCUMENT-001 (one unit per E item; spec §5's M-EDIT-001 candidate folds in by that rule). Judged: the file split Region.cs/EditDocument.cs/TimeMath.cs follows the type names of the form, which is J. Alternatives: one Document.cs, or a file per type including KeptPiece.

disagreements.reason_1: Signatures only; the behaviour is SPEC-HISTORY-001. A typed operation model would give them; the Try-pattern and class/record style need a stated style rule.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: ruled_ref IF-HISTORY-01; Snapshot/TryUndo/TryRedo/Clear and capacity 50 from 20-spec §2.4. Judged: the generic constraint `where T : class`, out parameters, the added CanUndo/CanRedo, the max constructor parameter (form, §4.5 P1 ③). Alternatives: a non-generic history of documents, nullable returns instead of out parameters, no CanUndo/CanRedo.

disagreements.reason_1: One unit per E item, the artifact path is the E item's planned_output_artifact_ref; file names are one file per public type of the form. No written rule maps E items to units 1:1.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: ebom_refs [E-MEDIA-TOOLS-001] and the folder src/MoviePad.Core/Media from E-MEDIA-TOOLS-001. Alternatives: one MediaTools.cs holding the result type, or a locator and a runner file.

disagreements.reason_1: One unit per E item, the artifact path is the E item's planned_output_artifact_ref; file names are one file per public type of the form. No written rule maps E items to units 1:1.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: ebom_refs [E-PROBE-001]. Judged: the artifact is the Media folder, not E-PROBE-001's MediaProbe.cs, and ClipInfo.cs is added as its own file (the form's type, J). Alternatives: E-PROBE-001's single MediaProbe.cs with ClipInfo inside it.

disagreements.reason_1: A1 rule 5 gives a requires targeting IF-MEDIA-TOOLS-01 (the E item requires it). The written value targets PS-M-MEDIA-TOOLS-001-P01, which A1 rule 4 forbids (a1_check.py).
disagreements.reason_2: E-PROBE-001 requires IF-MEDIA-TOOLS-01; the requires targets the provides item that realises it (PS-M-MEDIA-TOOLS-001-P01) and depends_on its unit. A1 1/5 would give target IF-MEDIA-TOOLS-01 and A1 4 bars a PS- target between units of different E items; the recorded IF->realising-PS mapping is the practice the layer follows.

disagreements.reason_1: The IF part is A1 rule 5 (four IFs); the ffmpeg procurement target needs a stated rule (a unit whose K item names a procured tool requires it). The written value omits IF-OUTPUT-SETTINGS-01 (the form passes width/height/fps) and targets PS- items (A1 rules 4 and 5 fail).
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: R01/R02/R05 map E-EXPORT-001's IF-DOCUMENT-01, IF-PROBE-01, IF-MEDIA-TOOLS-01 to their realising provides. Judged: IF-OUTPUT-SETTINGS-01, which E-EXPORT-001 requires, is dropped (the request takes raw size and rate; A1 5 would ask for it), and procurement:ffmpeg is required here only, not by the tools or the probe. Alternatives: a requires on IF-OUTPUT-SETTINGS-01 with settings in the request; procurement:ffmpeg on the tools unit or nowhere.

disagreements.reason_1: The E item's acceptance_refs minus the rows listed in mbom.assembly (CP-EXPORT-VFR-001); statable.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: E-EXPORT-001's acceptance_refs. Judged: CP-EXPORT-VFR-001 is moved to mbom.assembly only while CP-EXPORT-OUTPUT-001, also whole exports, stays on the unit (A2 lets the AI choose the placement).

disagreements.reason_1: Types and members restate SPEC-EXPORT-001 (formats, errors, progress) as C#; a typed operation model plus a style rule would give them.
disagreements.reason_2: Mechanical: ruled_ref IF-EXPORT-01; the request fields and error kinds from 20-spec §2.6. Judged: 20-spec §1 leaves the exporter's request/result/progress types to the M-BOM; ExportProgress fields, ExportResult shape, enum names, raw size and rate in the request. Alternatives: OutputSettings in the request, exceptions for errors, a progress fraction only.

disagreements.reason_1: Responsibility allocation between the exporter and its caller.
disagreements.reason_2: 20-spec §2.9: the keyframe time 'is given as copyStartOverride; when absent or outside [0, spanStart], the span start is used' - so the exporter does not look it up.

disagreements.reason_1: Argument order and the mov muxer options: ffmpeg knowledge and choice beyond the spec.

disagreements.reason_1: Edge behaviour (empty env var, a token already cancelled) chosen; arguably spec content.

disagreements.reason_1: A null policy for result fields chosen.
disagreements.reason_2: 20-spec §2.6 says FfmpegFailed carries the exit code and the last 8 lines and is silent for the other kinds; null-otherwise is a promise on the result, not a way to build it.

disagreements.reason_1: Pass a missing directory through vs create it vs refuse: chosen.
disagreements.reason_2: Errors 1-4 of 20-spec §2.6 do not cover a missing directory and K-FFMPEG-001 says write directly to the output path, so ffmpeg's failure is error 5; the request carries the full output path.

disagreements.reason_1: Keep a public form unchanged across a unit merge: a statable change rule.
disagreements.reason_2: Analyze's parameter list vs taking the request type: an API-shape choice kept for history (ECO-005), with equally reasonable alternatives.

disagreements.reason_1: The ffprobe command and keyframe reading: knowledge of ffprobe and of the authority.
